items.title: Finiteness of the group of units modulo constants for an integral locally finite type scheme over an algebraically closed field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Over an algebraically closed field k, for an integral scheme X locally of finite type, the lemma shows that O^*(X)/k^* is a finitely generated abelian group (statement lines 5245-5250). The proof reduces the case at hand to the normal proper case by two moves that each need justification: since X is integral the restriction to a nonempty open is injective on functions, so one may assume X affine, and then X is realized as a nonempty open of a projective variety by taking the closure in projective space (proof lines 5253-5261). The normalization of that projective variety is finite, dominant and normal, and the author verifies that it stays a proper variety because properness is stable under finite morphisms and composition, and that it surjects onto the original variety because the image is closed and contains the generic point; since the inverse image of the affine open is then the scheme to which the previous normal case applies, the reduction is complete (proof lines 5263-5282). The claim is H2: the whole content is the reduction, with the previous normality lemma doing the actual counting.
